# SystemTime

Win32's `SYSTEMTIME`: a broken-down date and time, one field per component.

```rux
pub struct SystemTime {
    // private fields
}
```

Whether it is UTC or local time is decided by the call that filled it, not by the record — [`GetSystemTime`](/docs/api/windows/clock#get-system-time) gives
one and [`GetLocalTime`](/docs/api/windows/clock#get-local-time) the other, and nothing here distinguishes them afterwards.
The fields are private: `Rux/Time` is the calendar interface, and this exists so a Win32 signature can name the
record it takes.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/minwinbase/ns-minwinbase-systemtime](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/minwinbase/ns-minwinbase-systemtime)
